suggested_title: Longsha Liu - MD Candidate at Stanford School of Medicine
prospect_notes: Longsha Liu is an MD candidate at Stanford University School of Medicine and a 2022 Knight-Hennessy Scholar. He graduated Phi Beta Kappa from Cornell University (Ithaca) with a B.S. in Neurobiology and a minor in Business for the Life Sciences, receiving the Cornell Hunter Rawlings Presidential Research Scholar award and the 2021 Cornell Student Business of the Year award. At Cornell, he co-founded Cornell Biomedical Device and Vita Innovations, a MedTech startup focused on patient monitoring for emergency medicine. Before Stanford, he completed a SENS Research Fellowship at Harvard Medical School focused on novel glioblastoma therapeutic design. At Stanford, he co-teaches courses on Generative AI in Healthcare (MED213 and MED216) and is active in the Society for Academic Emergency Medicine.
